# TRYOUT Sports Team Name Generator

> A free team name generator covering 198 sports. It builds names in the browser from
> word lists rather than returning a fixed list, so every click gives 30 new names.
> Made by TRYOUT Sports, a custom sportswear and team uniform manufacturer.

## What it does

- Generates 30 team names per click for any of 198 sports, grouped into 14 categories.
- Eight naming styles: classic, fierce, funny, cute, royal, mythical, spooky, space.
- Four team types: a team, a sports club, a school or college team, or a community group.
- Options for name length (1, 2 or 3 words), a city or school name, and a free-text description.
- Free, no sign-up, no account. Nothing is stored and nothing is sent to a server.

## How the names are made

Names are assembled in the browser from word lists: sport-specific words, mascot words,
animals, describing words, real city names and club words. There is no fixed list of names,
so the same settings produce different names each time.
